chunks: 3327 - Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"And the witnesses should not refuse when they are called."
He عليه السلام said: "Before the testimony."
And regarding His saying, Mighty and Majestic:
"And whoever conceals it, then indeed his heart is sinful."
He عليه السلام said: "After the testimony."

key_terms.الشَّهَادَةِ: testimony or witness-bearing in a legal context
key_terms.الشُّهَدَاءُ: the witnesses who are called to give testimony
key_terms.دُعُوا: they are summoned or called upon
key_terms.قَلْبُهُ: his heart, indicating inner moral culpability
key_terms.يَكْتُمْهَا: conceals it, meaning hides the testimony

ai.seo_question: What do the Quranic verses about witnesses being called and concealing testimony mean?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام explains that the verse commanding witnesses not to refuse applies before testimony is given, meaning one should respond when called to bear witness. He also explains that concealing testimony applies after testimony has become due, stressing the seriousness of withholding the truth.
